response.sql: WITH filtered_labs AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, GOT, GPT, APPT, PT FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5), by_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT END) as avg_got_minus_gpt, AVG(CASE WHEN APPT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APPT - PT END) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM filtered_labs GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_got_minus_gpt), AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt) FROM by_status

assumptions.assumption: Records are filtered separately for each difference: a record missing GOT or GPT is excluded from the GOT−GPT average, while a record missing APPT or PT is excluded from the APPT−PT average. A single record may contribute to one average but not the other.

alternatives.interpretation: All four values (GOT, GPT, APPT, PT) must be non-NULL to include a record at all; both averages are then computed over the same filtered set.
alternatives.sql: WITH filtered_labs AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, GOT, GPT, APPT, PT FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5 AND GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL AND APPT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL), by_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(GOT - GPT) as avg_got_minus_gpt, AVG(APPT - PT) as avg_appt_minus_pt FROM filtered_labs GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_got_minus_gpt), AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt) FROM by_status
